basis: Visual inspection of normalized contact sheet and previous idle, running-right, waiting, failed source strips; no video playback independently inspected.

observations.identity: Round brown featherball, amber eyes, dark beak and short attached wings remain consistent across the sheet.
observations.idle: Eyes close and reopen across intermediate poses; body and baseline visually stable relative to older head-bob.
observations.running-right/left: Facing directions correct; wing positions change modestly while feet remain nearly anchored. Flight cadence is subtle.
observations.waving: Short attached wing extends and returns toward the body.
observations.jumping: Small upward displacement and return to grounded pose visible.
observations.failed: Eyes lower gradually with a modest centered bow and recover, a subdued reaction.
observations.waiting: Small head and wing changes suggest expectation; first and last close in the reordered strip.
observations.running: Small left/right scanning and concentrated eyes distinguish it from idle.
observations.review: Downward gaze conveys inspection before returning to neutral.
observations.registration: Bodies and feet broadly stable; no obvious detached limbs or clipping in contact sheet. Most first/last poses visually close.

warnings: Failed expression is understated and can read as tired or annoyed rather than disappointed.
Flight and waiting motion are deliberately subtle; assess readability at normal size during playback.
Wave final pose remains slightly raised relative to first; confirm return is smooth during playback.
Playback, timing and loop transitions were not independently verified.
